text:
ida: Heads up — PR #12012 is ready but gated on a short architecture note / RFC pointer. Can someone from arch give a lightweight bless? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/12012 RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1428

luis: pinged the RFC ticket and skimmed the PR. quick q: does this touch shard routing or is it just a client/runtime flag change?

ida: only client-side config + a small runtime flag to control KV-cache TTL. no routing changes. estimated SLO impact: ~+5ms p95 on short bursts, overall QPS unaffected. canary should be low-traffic.

kai: can we attach a 1hr canary window? I can run the canary at 16:00 PT tomorrow. we need arch note for merge gating.

luis: i can review today. i need a tiny arch brief here (1 paragraph) that lists: what changes, plausible failure modes, fallback route, rollback signal/metric to watch. if you paste it here i can bless after a quick read.

ida: okay added a mini-arch brief to the PR description and pasting here: "This change exposes a per-prefix KV-cache TTL flag to callers and a matching runtime switch. Purpose: reduce stale-prefix memory growth for short-lived inference sessions. Failure modes: incorrect TTL may increase cache-miss storm or slightly raise token latency; misconfig could cause higher memory churn. Fallback: runtime will route to model-variant-b (stable quantized variant) when cache warms fail. Rollback signal: spike in runtime.cache.prefix_miss_rate > 5% and p95 latency > +15ms."

luis: thanks — couple quick asks before i sign off: 1) add an explicit metric name for the cache-miss signal, 2) confirm fallback route is model-variant-b (exact name), 3) note who will own canary monitoring.

ida: will update in PR. metric name -> runtime.cache.prefix_miss_rate; fallback -> model-variant-b-v2; canary monitoring owner -> kai (i'll add him to the PR review).

maia: fyi release coord: if we do 16:00 PT canary tomorrow i need confirmation to block that window in the release calendar. please confirm and i'll create the entry with rollback playbook attached.

deploy-bot: canary slot tentatively reserved: 2026-03-19 16:00 PT (please react with :white_check_mark: to confirm)

luis: reading the updated brief + metric. looks good overall; one nit: include the exact alert threshold (prefix_miss_rate > 5% sustained for 3m). otherwise i'll arch-bless once metric and alert are in PR.

ida: added the alert rule to the PR and the playbook note. pinging @luis for sign-off.

luis: LGTM — arch-approved. tiny brief covered failure modes and rollback path. @maia you can book the slot.

maia: booked 2026-03-19 16:00 PT in calendar and posted the canary notice in #releases. rollback owner set in playbook.

ida: great, thanks everyone. we'll hold merge until canary completes successfully and then merge + ship. :rocket:
